name: bar muscle-up
description: A muscle-up on a horizontal bar that pulls the chest above the bar and finishes with a press to straight arms.
instructions: Hang from a horizontal pull-up bar with a secure overhand grip and straight arms.
Pull strongly until the bar approaches your lower chest.
Lean your chest forward over the bar and rotate your wrists above it.
Press down on the bar to reach straight-arm support, then lower back to a hang with control.
